decisions.statement: The worker is in the foreground.
A simple unit runs the worker.
The worker runs from source rather than from a build.
Whatever the worker writes is appended to the worker log.
The file naming the running worker is written before the worker is reported.
A worker already named by that file and still alive refuses a second start.
A stop signal is carried through to the worker.
The file naming the running worker is cleared once the worker ends.
A worker ended by a signal this module took is a clean stop.
A worker that ended on its own answers with the code the worker ended on.

definition: the watcher worker started and held in the foreground until it ends
